implemented.pending: 30 realistic clean generated images; no embedded text; randomised each pending run; one image per second; image caption removed.
implemented.pois: Pending placeholders no longer count as resolved. Restaurant, fuel, rest and activity are explicitly resolved to named OSM places; accommodation uses stricter typed lookup.
implemented.map: Resolved POIs stay in plan.recommendations, so the existing map engine displays accommodation/food/fuel/rest/activity markers.
implemented.budget: Actual routed day kilometres, country-aware fuel/lodging/food/parking assumptions, realistic room count, low/expected/high range and confidence.
implemented.base_trip: 5-day base-plan logic now searches alternative reachable bases if the initially best-scoring base lacks the required number of distinct day trips.
